name: 70037 · Belle Chasse, LA
findings: ZIP 70037 (Belle Chasse) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70037 (Belle Chasse) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
